SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM INVOICES i
       LEFT JOIN CLIENTS c ON c.CLIENT_ID = i.CLIENT_ID
       JOIN MOVIE_FUNCTIONS f ON f.MOVIE_FUNCTION_ID = i.MOVIE_FUNCTION_ID
       JOIN MOVIES m ON m.MOVIE_ID = f.MOVIE_ID
       JOIN THEATERS t ON t.THEATER_ID = f.THEATER_ID
       JOIN CINEMAS b ON b.BRANCH_ID = t.BRANCH_ID
       WHERE i.STATUS IN ('PAID', 'CANCELLED')

SELECT i.INVOICE_ID AS ID,
       TO_CHAR(i.CREATED_AT AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS PURCHASED_AT,
       CASE WHEN i.CLIENT_ID IS NULL THEN 'Invitado' ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(c.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || c.SECOND_NAME || ' ' || c.FIRST_SURNAME || ' ' || c.SECOND_SURNAME, ' +', ' ')) END AS CLIENT_NAME, COALESCE(i.BUYER_EMAIL,c.EMAIL) AS CLIENT_EMAIL,
       COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(i.PURCHASE_CONTEXT,'$.function.title'),m.TITLE) AS MOVIE_TITLE, COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(i.PURCHASE_CONTEXT,'$.function.branchName'),TRIM(b.NAME)) AS BRANCH_NAME, COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(i.PURCHASE_CONTEXT,'$.function.theaterId' RETURNING NUMBER),f.THEATER_ID) AS THEATER_ID,
       COALESCE(SUBSTR(JSON_VALUE(i.PURCHASE_CONTEXT,'$.function.startsAt'),1,16),TO_CHAR(f.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI')) AS FUNCTION_START,
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(l.QUANTITY), 0)
          FROM INVOICE_PRODUCTS l
          JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = l.PRODUCT_ID
         WHERE l.INVOICE_ID = i.INVOICE_ID AND p.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'TICKET') AS TICKETS,
       i.TOTAL, i.STATUS
       FROM INVOICES i
       LEFT JOIN CLIENTS c ON c.CLIENT_ID = i.CLIENT_ID
       JOIN MOVIE_FUNCTIONS f ON f.MOVIE_FUNCTION_ID = i.MOVIE_FUNCTION_ID
       JOIN MOVIES m ON m.MOVIE_ID = f.MOVIE_ID
       JOIN THEATERS t ON t.THEATER_ID = f.THEATER_ID
       JOIN CINEMAS b ON b.BRANCH_ID = t.BRANCH_ID
       WHERE i.STATUS IN ('PAID', 'CANCELLED')
       ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT DESC, i.INVOICE_ID DESC
       OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :pageSize ROWS ONLY

SELECT a.movie_function_id,
       a.theater_id,
       a."TIME",
       a."DATE",
       a.seat_row,
       (SELECT MIN(s.column_number)
          FROM Seats s
         WHERE s.theater_id = a.theater_id
           AND s.row_number = a.seat_row
           AND s.seat_state <> 'indisponible'
           AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM Tickets tk
                WHERE tk.movie_function_id = a.movie_function_id
                  AND tk.seat_row    = s.row_number
                  AND tk.seat_column = s.column_number)) AS seat_column
FROM (
    SELECT mf.movie_function_id,
           mf.theater_id,
           mf.start_time,
           TO_CHAR(mf.start_time, 'HH24:MI') AS "TIME",
           TO_CHAR(mf.screening_date, 'FMDD "de" month, YYYY',
                   'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE = SPANISH') AS "DATE",
           (SELECT MIN(s.row_number)
              FROM Seats s
             WHERE s.theater_id = mf.theater_id
               AND s.seat_state <> 'indisponible'
               AND NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM Tickets tk
                    WHERE tk.movie_function_id = mf.movie_function_id
                      AND tk.seat_row    = s.row_number
                      AND tk.seat_column = s.column_number)) AS seat_row
      FROM Tickets t
      JOIN Movie_functions cur ON cur.movie_function_id = t.movie_function_id
      JOIN Theaters cur_th     ON cur_th.theater_id = cur.theater_id
      JOIN Movie_functions mf  ON mf.movie_id = cur.movie_id
      JOIN Theaters mf_th      ON mf_th.theater_id = mf.theater_id
                                         AND mf_th.branch_id  = cur_th.branch_id
     WHERE t.tickets_id = :tickets_id
       AND mf.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND mf.start_time > GREATEST(SYSTIMESTAMP, cur.start_time)
       AND mf.start_time < SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '7' DAY
) a
WHERE a.seat_row IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.start_time
